rows.en: Touya: "...So it's over now, right?"
Lodis: "Yes. That just leaves Cain."
Touya: "...What about him?"
Lodis: "Cain is probably in the royal capital..."
Touya: "The royal capital? No wonder we haven't seen him..."
Celica: "Wait, Brother!
Does that mean he's after Tix?!"
Lodis: "There's no doubt about it.
But there's no need to worry."
Touya: "But... Isn't Tix the only one at the palace...?"
Lodis: "It'll be fine if we leave it to him."
Touya: "Him...? Don't tell me this has something to do
with that 'request' you mentioned earlier..."
Lodis: "Well, yes. Right now, at the palace..."
Tix: "No! I can't go with you anymore!"
Cain: "Is the suggestion not working?
No, that doesn't seem to be the case...
Well, never mind. Your wishes don't matter.
There's no time left.
At this rate, Lodis will be a hero.
I need you to step forward before that happens."
Tix: "Why do you hate my brother so much?!
Enough to use me like this!
We were friends, weren't we?!"
Cain: "Heh heh heh... You sheltered little princeling...
Listen. Not once have I ever thought
of you as a friend. I was merely humoring you."
Tix: "No..."
Cain: "You really are a fool...
Rayfon is the only person I ever acknowledged..."
Tix: "But Big Brother Rayfon..."
Cain: "I'm tired of talking to you...
Oh, yes. I've just had a good idea..."
Tix: "C-Cain...?"
Cain: "Why didn't I think of it before?
There was such a simple way...
He'll be sad if you die..."
Tix: "Stop it... Stop it, Cain..."
Cain: "...Goodbye..."
Tyron: "Oh... A fine sword stroke.
But your step is too shallow."
Cain: "Y-You... You're alive..."
Tix: "T-Tyron!"
Tyron: "It's been a while, Prince.
I failed to protect His Majesty, yet failed to die myself."
Cain: "...Tch!"
Tix: "Ah! Cain!"
Tyron: "Throwing your sword and fleeing...
Unworthy conduct for a warrior,
but the correct decision, perhaps..."
Tyron: "What a waste... He could become a fine general
if he followed the right path..."
Tyron: "I have come on the orders of His Majesty King Lodis and our new sovereign,
Her Majesty Ciel."
Tix: "Huh? Her Majesty... Ciel?"
Tyron: "For certain reasons, Ciel now guides us all.
And I shall serve as your guard
for a while, Prince."
Growster: "...Thank you for your help this time."
Touya: "Seriously. First you lose, then you show up as our enemy."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya!"
Growster: "Gah ha ha ha! It's fine, it's fine.
The boy's right. But now that I'm back to normal,
I'll put right what needs putting right."
Lodis: "Even if it costs you your people's trust?"
Growster: "Of course. But our people can tell
right from wrong. Regaining trust once it's lost
is no easy thing,
but if we face them properly, they'll understand.
That's what I believe."
Lodis: "...I see. Then let me give you
this disc."
Celica: "The disc we got at that research institute...?
Wait, Brother!"
Lodis: "I thought I'd put my trust in him too."
Growster: "...I might turn around and cover up the evidence,
you know. What would you do then?"
Lodis: "I'd be in trouble."
Growster: "...Heh... In trouble, eh? Heh heh heh.
I see... Gah ha ha ha ha!"
Ai: "Hey, what's with that old man?
Have the drugs finally gone to his head?"
Kasumi: "A-Ai-chan, if he hears you..."
Ai: "It's fine. He's off in his own world anyway."
Growster: "...I can hear you perfectly well."
Ai: "...Urk."
Growster: "...Well, never mind.
If this offer came from Revios, I'd have no hesitation
about putting him in trouble..."
Growster: "As commander-in-chief of the Republic of Zigrim's armed forces,
I, Nagarek Growster, humbly
accept your offer."
Lodis: "Heh heh heh. Yes.
I hope this will mark the beginning
of repairing relations between our countries."
Growster: "That is a politician's job, rather than a soldier's.
But I promise to do what I can."
Lodis: "I pray this handshake will last forever."
Growster: "Yes."
Adjutant: "Your Excellency. We'll be busy from now on."
Growster: "Indeed. I'm counting on your abilities."
Adjutant: "Yes, sir!"
Fores: "Excuse us."
Miyasco: "Oh, Fores, Reamond."
Growster: "Are you all right now?"
Reamond: "Yes. I've calmed down considerably."
Touya: "Honestly, you really were reckless."
Reamond: "I'm ashamed of myself. But as a test subject,
even though I have a will of my own, I can't take my life
by my own choice... That's how I was made."
Touya: "So you tried to die by picking a reckless fight?
What good would that do?"
Reamond: "It was to settle everything. To erase the project.
That was all I'd been living for..."
Touya: "Even now?"
Reamond: "...No. There's someone who needs even me.
I'll spend the time I have left for that person...
I've come to think that way."
Fores: "..."
Growster: "What are you blushing for?"
Fores: "Wh...! Wh-Wh-What are you..."
Growster: "Gah ha ha ha!"
Lodis: "Then we'll take our leave for today.
Once things have settled down, I'd like to arrange
another opportunity for discussions."
Growster: "Understood."
Celica: "Then we'll be going too."
Touya: "See you."
Growster: "...Boy.
Don't let your guard down against ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Touya: "Heh, you don't have to tell me.
And don't you go starting any more pointless wars!"
Growster: "Heh...
Well, everyone, I wish you success in battle!"
Sisk: "...Oh!"
Ymir: "What is it?"
Sisk: "I'm detecting abnormal Prana levels. They're rising!"
Celica: "Wh-What are these readings...?"
Celica: "No... Aidion?! What's going on?!
It was supposed to be completely dead...
Why is it moving?!"
Rayfon: "...Hello. It seems I've surprised you."
Lodis: "!?"
Rayfon: "...It seems everyone's here.
Everyone aboard Liebhofen, it's a pleasure to meet you.
I'm Rayfon Lang Maxord..."
Celica: "It is you, Big Brother Rayfon...
Thank goodness... You're alive..."
Rayfon: "This is a one-way transmission,
so I'd appreciate it if you'd let me come aboard.
Would you mind opening the hatch?"
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Ymir: "Y-Yes, of course. Understood.
...Open the hatch! Miyasco, guide him in."
Miyasco: "Understood."
Sisk: "...To think the pilot in that Armored Mech who went missing three years ago
was Lord Rayfon."
Miyasco: "I know. I can't believe he was alive..."
Sisk: "Maybe His Highness will cheer up a little now.
After Lord Rayfon went missing,
he was so depressed..."
Derock: "Oh, it looks like he's here."
Celica: "Big Brother Rayfon! It really is you!"
Rayfon: "Yes... It's been a while, Celica.
You've grown even more beautiful while I was away.
You've cut your hair too... It suits you very well."
Celica: "Oh, Big Brother Rayfon!"
Lodis: "Rayfon..."
Rayfon: "Hello. I'm back... Mr. Lodis."
Lodis: "...Y-Yes..."
Rayfon: "Oh? The person there...
It seems you escaped safely."
Touya: "Yeah."
Ymir: "So the person Touya met in his dream really was..."
Touya: "Yeah. It was him."
Rayfon: "I was able to leave soon afterward too.
I stopped by the palace, then came here.
I wish I could have come a little sooner."
Celica: "Hey, so that really is Aidion?"
Rayfon: "Yes. In the distant past,
that mech came to Earth... The world the people over there
came from. It flew there from elsewhere."
Ai: "Huh? Then... It belonged to aliens?"
Arthur: "But how did it come to be here in Agarthia?"
Rayfon: "To fight that enormous object you witnessed,
Vorlia. The excess energy from their battle
was enough to destroy Earth.
So Aidion and the other two, Sivarius
and Coolmarishin, transformed the nature of that energy,
creating this Agarthia.
In other words, Earth and Agarthia are two sides of the same coin.
They are one and yet different,
while each influences the other."
Ymir: "Th-That's..."
Rayfon: "This may be hard to believe so suddenly,
but it's all true. Though all this knowledge
came from Grauzer, who is inside me."
Touya: "Grauzer?"
Rayfon: "Three years ago, during that explosion,
I should have died. The one who saved me
was Grauzer, who'd become a disembodied consciousness.
I didn't want to die. I wanted to live.
And when I came to, Grauzer and I had merged.
With Grauzer's power, we took refuge in that space."
Celica: "Did this person, Grauzer,
come here aboard Aidion?"
Rayfon: "Yes. I don't fully understand it myself,
but beyond Earth is something called space, and farther still,
another universe exists. Apparently, they came from there.
Their home is called 'Lin Karma,'
and it seems they originally share an ancestry
with the people of the solar system, though that isn't certain.
But the people of Lin Karma
and those of the solar system look so much alike
that the theory probably isn't wrong.
Grauzer was a scientist on Lin Karma who built Aidion,
Sivarius and Coolmarishin, the three Ultra-Offensive Shell Units,
the 'Shinkaio.'"
Touya: "...I don't get any of this..."
Ai: "So Agarthia is a world created by the fallout of a battle with Vorlia,
and the people who did it were from Lin Karma,
aliens, in other words.
And one of them, this Grauzer person's mind,
is living together with you inside your body.
And while we're at it, that person also made those three standing outside.
Is that right?"
Rayfon: "Very good. The other two should be arriving
soon, so I'll explain in detail after that."
Touya: "Hey, there's still more...?"
Clovis: "Come on, don't be like that.
We're gradually getting at the truth.
Doesn't it get you excited?"
Touya: "..."
Clovis: "Hey, are you listening?"
Touya: "Hey, do Lodis and Rayfon not get along?
The mood between them's been pretty tense..."
Ymir: "That shouldn't be the case.
They were very close... But now that you mention it,
I hadn't seen Lord Rayfon with him since before
he was caught in the explosion..."
Celica: "Big Brother Rayfon... Do you still feel that way about my brother...?"
Fain: "...Hmm? Hwah!"
Clovis: "Oh... So these are the two he mentioned..."
Derock: "Mmm... Quite a view..."
Touya: "...What are you guys doing...?
Hmm? Aah! You're the old man from back then!"
????: "Oh, have you been well?
...Hmm? What is it, Rishuna? What's that, introductions?
Oh, how careless of me.
A-Ahem. Ah, I'm Valga Solma.
Feel free to call me 'Valga-cchi.'"
Touya: "O-Okay..."
Valga: "What's this? You're no fun.
Well, never mind. And this lively young lady is...
Come on, what are you waiting for? Don't be shy. Say hello."
????: "U-Um... My name is Rishuna Milsh..."
Touya: "Are you guys aliens from that Lin Karma place too?"
Valga: "Yes. But unlike Rishuna here
and Grauzer, this is my own body."
Touya: "Your own body?"
Rishuna: "This body was originally that of a girl named Mana Elua,
and I'm 'borrowing' it.
It seems Grauzer's situation is different, though..."
Rayfon: "Grauzer trusts me."
Touya: "Huh... Hmm? Wait a minute...
You guys came here and created Agarthia, right?
Then just how old are you, old man?"
Valga: "It's rude to ask an old man his age.
My age and my three measurements are a secret."
Touya: "You're a strange old man.
Well, anyway, you've come to defeat those ≪Ze=Ode≫ guys
too, right?"
Rishuna: "Vorlia, rather than ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Celica: "Right, just what is this Vorlia?
Debish and Big Brother Rayfon both mentioned it..."
Rayfon: "Rishuna, would you explain?"
Rishuna: "Yes. Understood.
Rishuna: "...To put it simply, Vorlia is
a 'vessel.'
But what goes inside it is the 'consciousness' of intelligent life.
Vorlia was created to collect that 'consciousness.'
That is its purpose.
As such, Vorlia has no will of its own.
It merely carries out the command it was given:
'Collect consciousness.'"
Celica: "W-Wait, isn't that the same as what Dr. Debish
called his 'project'?"
Rishuna: "Yes. The ≪Ze=Ode≫ Spirit Mech he pilots
is merely one of Vorlia's extensions..."
Celica: "I see... But who made something like that,
for what purpose, and sent it here?"
Rishuna: "We know it was sent by people from another planet,
but as for their purpose...
It also seems that this isn't the only Vorlia.
They've been sent to various universes."
Touya: "There are more of those things?!"
Rishuna: "There have been no reports of multiple Vorlia
in the same galaxy.
But we have confirmed that more than one exists.
Our Lin Karma was effectively destroyed by Vorlia too.
Only the three of us escaped."
Touya: "This is getting pretty serious, but
if that Vorlia thing comes back,
does that mean everyone in this world will disappear?"
Valga: "Yes. What Vorlia wants is only
the information held by intelligent life in outer space.
It seems to have no interest in resources or technology.
In any world it visits, only living beings disappear.
Vorlia is called forth when the group that includes your Rayblade,
the six ≪Ze=Ode≫ Spirit Mechs,
comes together.
Now that the path is open again, the only way to stop it
is to destroy Vorlia itself."
Touya: "...And that's why you guys showed up?
Why didn't you until now...?"
Rayfon: "We... Or rather, those inside Rishuna and me,
the disembodied consciousnesses, along with Valga, somehow sealed Vorlia,
then fell asleep after exhausting their power."
Rishuna: "With Vorlia's reaction as the trigger to awaken us."
Valga: "I woke when Goderius revived,
but Grauzer was
in the gap between dimensions, so I couldn't do anything about him.
Rishuna and I had no choice but to attack Vorlia ourselves,
but pushing it back was all we could manage.
Dah ha ha ha!"
Yamato: "That old man's laughing about it..."
Touya: "So, what's the situation? Will it come back again?"
Rishuna: "Probably. But Vorlia has already appeared
here once. Perhaps it can be summoned even without all six
gathering together..."
Celica: "What?! Then there's nothing
we can do about it!"
Rayfon: "Now, calm down.
Several days have passed since then without any sign of it,
so there must be some factor involved, don't you think?"
Touya: "...You make it sound like it has nothing to do with you."
Rayfon: "I'm sorry if I've offended you.
But ultimately, our goal is the same as yours.
We have no intention of opposing you."
Rishuna: "..."
Valga: "In any case, for now we have no choice
but to work together on this."
Ymir: "That would help us too."
Rayfon: "There's something I need to do, so I'll be going now."
Celica: "Huh? But we only just got to see you..."
Rayfon: "Celica, it's hard for me to leave you too.
But this concerns all of Agarthia and Earth.
I'd be glad if you could understand."
Celica: "Yeah..."
Rayfon: "Heh heh... Good girl.
Well, everyone, farewell..."
Valga: "Now, shall we stay here for a while,
Rishuna?"
Rishuna: "...Huh? Oh, y-yes. Thank you for having us."
Rosalie: "Gen..."
Gen: "It can't be... We'd finally found each other...
Dad..."
Rosalie: "Gen, was it really Dad in that Armored Mech?
Couldn't you be mistaken...?"
Gen: "No! Just because I was little back then
doesn't mean I wouldn't know my own father!
Besides, he knew about the scar on my back."
Rosalie: "..."
Gen: "Only our family should know about this scar.
You, Mom and Dad..."
Rosalie: "B-But he abandoned us!
Even if someone like that comes back now..."
Gen: "Sis, do you really mean that?!
Dad might have had his own reasons,
you know!
And Dad protected me..."
Mechanic B: "Kid! We've just had word!
That pilot from earlier is alive!"
Gen: "What?!"
Mechanic B: "We found him during the recovery work.
He's in the infirmary getting..."
Mechanic B: "...Treatment now... Huh?"
Rosalie: "..."
Mechanic B: "Hmm? Aren't you going?
Anyway, he's in the infirmary. See you."
Rosalie: "...Now...? It's too late now..."
Gen: "Dad! Dad!"
Gabon: "Shh. He's sleeping now.
I know how you feel, but he was badly wounded.
Leave him in peace for now."
Gen: "Huh? Then Dad is..."
Gabon: "Hey, Gen. Who do you think I am? Hmm?"
Gen: "All right! Uncle Gabon!
You're the best!"
Gabon: "Ha ha ha! Well, that's how it is,
so be patient just a little longer."
Gen: "Th-Then... Can I just see his face?
I promise I won't make a sound..."
Gabon: "...Can't be helped, then. Just for a moment, okay?
And don't tell Miyasco.
Maki is sleeping too, and Miyasco is strict about this sort of thing."
Gen: "Yeah! It's a promise between men."
Gabon: "All right. This way..."
